game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild

author: jeromyyyyy
quote: This game is not worth the wait. Im disappointed not only by the frame limit, which of course is partially hardware based, but capping the frames at 30 after 13 years of development is absolutely insane. Besides that, the story just isnt as captivating as I expected it to be. Really disappointed...
